🖥️ Witch I, on the shelf

17 October 2026. The box has a door.

The programs are files now, under shelf/, and the extension is .wasic. SHELF reads the catalog. UNSEAL "shelf:HELLO-WITCH" takes one down. HELLO-DEMON is the other hello. CAROL hums. FAMILIAR paces.

When she wakes, the white witch from the banner stands in the glass while the count climbs. Then the words roll up and the glass says SPEAK.

A refusal is red, with a mark, and two notes going down. The walls she keeps are in SYSTEM.md.
